packageRules.description: Keep every GitHub Action pinned to a full commit SHA (with synced # vX.Y.Z comment). validate-workflows.mjs hard-fails any non-SHA uses:.

Linter/formatter binaries whose machine output validate-kit parses. A bump can silently reshape JSON and zero findings, so isolate each one and gate it on regenerated golden fixtures (see scripts/regen-goldens.mjs). Mirror the new version into mise.toml.
Digest-pin container images (workflow container:/services: and helper scripts). validate-workflows.mjs hard-fails any workflow image: without @sha256.
